about_the_game:
Rogum A Cat Match Puzzle Demo

In this demo, you will play through 10 Levels that give you a taste of the full adventure. Some puzzles throw you against Enemies, others send you through Portals, and one even challenges you with a Boss Fight.
Match the blocks, outsmart the dangers, and see if you can keep the cat safe as the water keeps rising.

short_description: Rogum A Cat Match Puzzle is a puzzle adventure where you help a clever cat escape a mysterious dream world. Match blocks, race against the rising water, and face obstacles across mysterious islands. With 50 levels, it challenges your memory, focus, and quick reactions. Can you save the cat?
